page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge exhibits modest processing capabilities. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show average performance for large-block read and write operations, though small-block cached reads fall into the bottom 25%. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip single-threaded compression, register in the bottom 10%, while Passmark CPU extended instructions and overall CPU scores achieve average tier rankings.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its high memory capacity relative to its lower-tier CPU compute performance. With 64 GB of RAM but weak single-core and multi-core processing metrics, it is less suitable for compute-intensive workloads, high-throughput web serving, or large-scale LLM inference. However, the memory allocation makes it a viable option for memory-bound workloads that do not require high CPU frequency, such as caching layers, moderate database operations, or lightweight enterprise applications requiring a larger memory footprint without high compute density.
